# ![](images/rtide.png){width=100px} Welcome to R-Tide

**R-Tide** is a community-driven movement where **R** users learn together, share discoveries, and ride the wave of the R ecosystem together.

We believe that the best way to stay current isn't to passively consume, but to actively learn alongside others. Whether you're wrangling data with the tidyverse, building interactive dashboards with Shiny, or publishing beautiful reports with Quarto, R-Tide is here so we can all grow together.

:::

---

<!-- The Problem / Why R-Tide -->
::: {style="background-color: #f8f9fa; padding: 2.5rem; border-radius: 12px; margin: 2rem 0;"}
The R ecosystem moves quickly. New packages are released every day. Shiny continues to evolve. Quarto keeps introducing powerful publishing features. Staying current is exciting, but it can also feel overwhelming.

**R-Tide exists to make that journey collaborative.**

Rather than trying to keep up alone, we learn from each other's discoveries, questions, experiments, and experiences. Every edition reflects what the community is exploring, because when one of us learns something new, we all move forward together.
:::

## The Story Behind R-Tide

R-Tide started with a simple observation: keeping up with R is hard to do alone.

Not because the community isn't sharing—it's sharing *constantly*. Blogs, tweets, LinkedIn posts, conference talks, package releases, YouTube tutorials. It's a firehose of amazing content.

The problem isn't a lack of information. It's that **information isn't the same as learning**.

Learning happens through conversation, experimentation, and shared experience. It happens when someone explains a concept differently, demonstrates a workflow, or asks a question that sparks a new way of thinking.

R-Tide was created to be that space. A place where we don't simply collect links, but build understanding together.

> The tide is predictable, powerful, gains strength through momentum, and lifts everything in its path. That's exactly what we want R-Tide to be for the R community—a rising wave that carries all of us forward, together.
